content.comment_body: Hi, I’m new to this and finding it a bit challenging. I need help generating a short pulse signal (from 0 to 1 and back to 0) triggered by my weekly timer reaching 1, which should start my state machine. Any suggestions?

Even for those just starting out, it would help a lot if you could describe your problem in a bit more detail. Are you looking for signal edges (both rising and falling) for switching actions? By the way, feedback on your previous topics would be appreciated.
Check out these logic blocks: AND (Edge) and NAND (Edge).
Could someone please confirm if the solution I attached is correct? Thanks.
Yes, your approach using an M-bit with an XOR combination achieves the trigger described in your question.
I believe the topic creator is referring to this method...
Thank you both for your advice. I now have a couple of possible solutions to work with.
The blocks AND (Edge) and NAND (Edge) are specifically suited to solve your issue.
If you only need a positive edge from the weekly timer, set just the 'on' time and check the box for 'Pulse Output' in the settings.
